arch_opening: There is a critical release available — version 2.5.0. It changes Codex role-file upgrades and adds measurable cost guardrails. I will check what applies before acknowledging it.

changes.title: Codex role files are lean project deltas
changes.what_changed: Fresh Codex projects receive small role-delta files while the installed skill remains canonical. Existing custom role files change only with `./upgrade codex --migrate-role-files <project>`, which copies each file to a timestamped backup first.
changes.old_behavior: Fresh projects copied full workflow role templates and existing custom local files had no explicit slimming migration.
changes.new_behavior: The migration is opt-in, backup-producing, and never happens during a normal upgrade.
changes.user_impact_plain: Your custom personas remain untouched unless you explicitly choose the migration.
changes.how_to_assess: Review local role customizations; migrate only after confirming the timestamped backup location.
changes.user_decision: Do you want to migrate local Codex role files to lean deltas after preserving their backups?

changes.title: Fresh-context budgets and aggregate local usage audit
changes.what_changed: Role budgets now warn/checkpoint at 85K/100K Architect, 75K/90K Builder, and 50K/60K Reviewer. `scripts/codex-usage-audit.py` aggregates final cumulative JSONL usage per session without emitting message content.
changes.old_behavior: Budget guidance lacked warning thresholds and local evidence was manual.
changes.new_behavior: Every child route preserves `fork_turns: none`; usage evidence is aggregate-only and estimates are labelled.
changes.user_impact_plain: Long work checkpoints sooner and review requests can cite privacy-preserving aggregate usage.
changes.how_to_assess: Run the audit locally if session JSONL is available; compare only aggregate counts, not conversation contents.

changes.title: Codex Builder and Reviewer default to Luna/Max
changes.what_changed: The active Codex skill and Architect template now route every Builder and Reviewer spawn to gpt-5.6-luna with reasoning_effort max and fork_turns none. Alternate fallback, inheritance, and critical-child routes do not exist.
changes.old_behavior: The Builder defaulted to Terra/medium, the Reviewer defaulted to Luna/medium, and later drafts introduced alternate fallback and critical-child routing.
changes.new_behavior: Architect routing remains unchanged. Every Builder and Reviewer spawn uses Luna/Max with fresh context; unavailable Luna blocks the spawn and is reported to the Product Owner.
changes.user_impact_plain: Bob and Richard always run on the one model-and-effort configuration selected by the Product Owner. The framework never silently substitutes another child configuration.
changes.how_to_assess: Check codex-skill/SKILL.md and codex-skill/references/role-templates/ARCHITECT.md for one Luna/Max route per role, no alternate child route, and explicit unavailable-Luna blocking behavior.
